segments.text:
V. 13.
And he was there forty days, tempted by Satan—Inviſibly. After this followed the Temptation by him in a viſible Shape, related by St. Matthew. And he was with the wild beaſts—Tho' they had no Power to hurt Him. St. Mark not only gives us a Compendium of St. Matthew's Goſpel, but likewiſe ſeveral valuable Particulars, which the other Evangeliſts have omitted.
